period_status: Measured primary interval agrees with the published Gaia spectroscopic orbit.
claim_basis: earlier public machine or TESS pipeline detection
prior_evidence: SPOC two-minute threshold-crossing event 00305928109-01. Gaia DR3 SB1 at 14.09130 days.
interpretation: Three narrow primary eclipses identify the known Gaia SB1. Its radial-velocity period is 14.09130 days and its 35.0 km/s velocity semiamplitude establishes a stellar companion. Both primary-difference images favor the source. No secondary was secured.

interpretation: Both minima localize to the star in three sectors. The primary changed from about 5% in sector 22 to 11% in sectors 45 and 46. Both predicted primary windows in sector 72 show no comparable eclipse. The cause of the depth change and the orbital configuration remain open.
